nonlinear_hgb_models.missing_score_rule: retain NaN; HistGradientBoostingClassifier handles missing values natively

logistic_models_including_semantic_score.missing_score_rule: within each training fold, compute the median of each semantic score using finite training-fold values only; impute that training-fold median into missing semantic values in both training and held-out rows
logistic_models_including_semantic_score.has_note_rule: retain prespecified has_note comparator feature so imputed no-note rows remain distinguishable from observed-note rows
logistic_models_including_semantic_score.complete_note_available_requirement: note-available rows must have all eight semantic scores; otherwise fail the analysis rather than silently impute model-inference failures

tfidf_no_note_rule: rows without an eligible note receive an all-zero TF-IDF vector; has_note remains in the comparator
rationale: Logistic regression cannot consume NaN. Fold-specific training medians avoid held-out leakage while has_note preserves the distinction between no-note rows and observed notes.
